quarterly_data.quarter: Jiangsu Novoray New Material IR activity record: 2026-003 (09-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): products are functional advanced powders - micron and submicron angular powders, micron-to-nano spherical powders, other ultrafine particles and liquid fillers - used in chip-packaging epoxy molding compound (EMC), liquid molding compound (LMC), granular molding compound (GMC), underfill (UF), electronic circuit substrates (CCL), build-up film (BF) and thermal materials. The company focuses on high-end chip (AI, 5G, HPC) packaging, heterogeneous advanced packaging (Chiplet, HBM) and next-generation high-frequency high-speed CCL (M8, M9, M10), launching low-cut-point, surface-modified, Low-alpha micron/submicron spherical silica, Low-alpha spherical alumina and ultra-low-loss spherical silica for high-speed CCL; certification of its liquid-phase spherical silica is accelerating, and the revenue share of higher-end products is rising.

quarterly_data.quarter: Jiangsu Novoray New Material IR activity record: 2026-003 (09-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): in H1 2026 base products (angular silica, general spherical silica, spherical alumina) gained market share, while high-growth products - submicron spherical silica and alumina, Low-alpha spherical silica and alumina, liquid-phase spherical silica - sped up certification in advanced packaging, high-performance circuit substrates and thermal materials and grew sales quickly, offsetting FX losses, convertible-bond interest and energy-cost swings. Looking ahead, management expects the product mix to improve further as advanced packaging penetrates and high-performance substrates upgrade.

quarterly_data.quarter: Jiangsu Novoray New Material IR activity record: 2026-003 (09-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): the 'ultra-pure spherical powder for high-performance high-speed substrates' project - phase 1 is complete, phase 2 is under construction and phase 3 will be accelerated to meet growing AI, HPC and high-speed communication demand for key high-speed substrate fillers; on strong advanced-packaging and circuit-substrate demand, capacity utilization is at a high level.
